maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is asset management fees on money market, fixed income and equity funds, not repair or maintenance of installed things.

publicly_funded.reason: Fees come from investors in its funds, including institutions, corporations and retail clients, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own funds and strategies; Hermes was a large deal but acquisitions are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Investors can redeem and move money between fund managers fairly easily, though money market cash-management platforms add some stickiness.

notes: Largest revenue is money market fund management, so switching cost judgement is somewhat uncertain.
